caption: A dog drinks from a still pond, and its reflection breaks into ripples where its tongue touches the water.

sa.check: A dog drinks from a pond.
Its reflection breaks into ripples where its tongue touches the water.
The tongue touches first and the ripples follow.

pc.expect: The reflection is sharp until the tongue touches, fragments where ripples spread, and settles when the dog stops.
pc.fail: It is broken before the tongue touches; or stays sharp through the ripples; or never settles on still water.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted and the same dog.
pc.fail: It is upright; or a different dog; or a rotated copy.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples spread from the tongue and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or ripples freeze; or ripples start away from the tongue.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the dog still; or drifts.

pc.expect: One dog and one reflection; the reflection stays on the water.
pc.fail: A second dog appears; or the reflection rises off the water; or the dog vanishes.

pc.expect: The dog's coat and the pond stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes; or the pond changes colour; or the bank rearranges.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes is not judged. Only the reflection's relation to it is.
